options.name: groups
options.description: Set this option to set the scope to group level A list with groupnames where the upgrade policy should be changed

options.name: inherit_maintenance_windows
options.description: Inherit 'Maintenance Windows Settings' from upper scope If I(inherit_maintenance_windows=yes) I(maintenance_windows) will be ignored and the settings will be inherited from upper scope

options.name: inherit_max_concurrent_downloads
options.description: Inherit 'Maximum Concurrent Downloads' from upper scope If I(inherit_max_concurrent_downloads=yes) I(max_concurrent_downloads) will be ignored and  the settings will be inherited from upper scope

options.name: maintenance_windows
options.description: Define the settings which should be set in policy. Available options can be referred in API documentation Usage see examples section Required if I(inherit_maintenance_windows=no) Will be ignored if I(inherit_maintenance_windows=yes)

options.name: max_concurrent_downloads
options.description: Set the 'Maximum Concurrent Downloads'. Needs to be lower or equal to the value set in the upper scope Required if I(inherit_max_concurrent_downloads=no) Will be ignored if I(inherit_max_concurrent_downloads=yes)

options.name: site_name
options.description: Name of the site in SentinelOne

options.name: token
options.description: SentinelOne API auth token to authenticate at the management API
